name: Inflammation Context & Support Guidance
purpose: Connect inflammatory-pathway markers to plain-language context, a short set of foundational food and routine cues, and measured follow-up without treating DNA as a measure of current inflammation or a diagnosis.

domain_schema.lifestyle_null_semantics: A null lifestyle_recommendation explicitly means that this marker is useful as context but has no marker-specific lifestyle recommendation here.

lab_ids.name: High-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP)
lab_ids.purpose: Measured low-grade inflammatory context when a clinician considers it relevant.

lab_ids.name: C-reactive protein (CRP)
lab_ids.purpose: Measured inflammation context used with symptoms, timing, and the clinical question.

lab_ids.name: Erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR)
lab_ids.purpose: A nonspecific measured inflammatory signal interpreted with symptoms and other findings.

lab_ids.name: Fecal calprotectin
lab_ids.purpose: Stool inflammatory context when persistent bowel symptoms make inflammatory bowel disease part of the clinical question.

lab_ids.name: Complete blood count (CBC)
lab_ids.purpose: Blood-count context that can help interpret systemic symptoms or suspected inflammation.

lab_ids.name: Ferritin and transferrin saturation
lab_ids.purpose: Iron-storage and transport context when anemia, bleeding, malabsorption, or inflammation is being evaluated.

domains.label: Systemic inflammatory-signaling context
domains.context: Weak, context-dependent common-marker signals related to cytokine or measured-CRP research. These markers do not show whether inflammation is active now.

food_pattern: Vegetables, fruit, beans, and whole grains
Fatty fish or another omega-3 food source
routine: Use symptoms and recovery to set a tolerable movement routine
movement_recovery: Progress gradually and allow recovery days; DNA is not exercise clearance

do_not_claim: a need for an anti-inflammatory drug or supplement
domains.clinical_route: Use symptoms, recent illness, recovery, medications, and clinician-selected labs to decide whether the signal is useful.

domains.label: Immune and autoimmune context
domains.context: Immune signaling and autoimmune or bowel-disease research context that becomes more useful when symptoms, family history, examination, and measured findings point to a clinical question.
domains.no_lifestyle_reason: No marker-specific lifestyle recommendation is assigned here; use the relevant symptom, organ-system, and clinical follow-up route.
do_not_claim: a medication or supplement decision from a common SNP
domains.clinical_route: Route persistent or concerning symptoms to the relevant clinician; use blood, stool, imaging, or disease-specific testing when clinically indicated.

domains.label: Allergic and airway inflammation context
domains.context: Allergic, airway, skin-barrier, and mediator-pathway research context that is useful only when symptoms and exposures fit.
domains.no_lifestyle_reason: No DNA-directed food elimination or supplement recommendation is assigned to an allergy or airway marker.
domains.clinical_route: Use repeatable symptom and exposure patterns, appropriate allergy or airway testing, and clinician assessment.

domains.label: Digestive inflammatory context
domains.context: Inflammatory bowel and gut-barrier research context; the useful signals are persistent symptoms, objective testing, and clinical assessment.
domains.no_lifestyle_reason: No restrictive diet, probiotic, detox, or supplement plan is assigned from digestive inflammatory markers alone.
do_not_claim: a restrictive diet or digestive supplement plan from DNA
domains.clinical_route: If persistent diarrhea, bleeding, fever, weight change, nocturnal symptoms, anemia, or significant pain is present, use clinician-directed blood, stool, endoscopy, or imaging evaluation.

domains.label: Redox, fatty-acid, and tissue context
domains.context: Oxidative-stress, fatty-acid, oral, skin, tendon, joint, and tissue-remodeling research context that needs the relevant nutrient, examination, or symptom route.
domains.no_lifestyle_reason: This layer does not add a second diet or supplement prescription; use the existing nutrient, fatty-acid, recovery, dental, skin, or musculoskeletal route.
do_not_claim: a required antioxidant, selenium, or omega-3 dose
periodontal disease, arthritis, tendon, or skin disease diagnosis
domains.clinical_route: Use the relevant body-system assessment and measured status when a symptom or clinical question is present.

fallback.label: No marker-specific lifestyle recommendation
fallback.reason: The marker remains available as research or condition context; use the pack's phenotype, exposure, symptom, or lab route rather than adding a DNA-directed diet or supplement plan.

do_not_claim: an inflammatory disease diagnosis from common SNPs
an anti-inflammatory treatment, supplement, or restrictive diet from a marker alone
that a normal measured marker excludes all inflammatory disease
